74.title: Crash Rate increase (-5m)
74.query:
data record(version= array($appVersion))
| expand version


| join [
    fetch events
    | filter event.status == "ACTIVE"
    | filter event.category == "ERROR"
    | filter event.type == "MOBILE_APP_CRASH_RATE_INCREASED"
    | filter dt.source_entity in [
            fetch dt.entity.mobile_application
            | filter entity.name == $Application
            | fields id
        ]
    | parse event.description, "DATA 'version ' STRING:version ' increased' LD 'to ' DOUBLE:crash.rate.increase.percent ' %' LD"
    | filter now()-timestamp < duration(5, "m")
    | summarize crash.rate.increase.percent = takeMax(crash.rate.increase.percent), by: { version}
], on: { version}, fields: { crash.rate.increase.percent }, kind:leftOuter
| fieldsAdd crash.rate.increase.percent = coalesce(crash.rate.increase.percent, 0)
| fieldsAdd version = concat(version, "v")
| sort crash.rate.increase.percent desc
// by: jose.romero@dynatrace.com

80.title: Crash Rate increase history
80.query:
data record(version= array($appVersion))
| expand version

| join [
    fetch events
    | filter event.category == "ERROR"
    | filter event.type == "MOBILE_APP_CRASH_RATE_INCREASED"
    | filter dt.source_entity in [
            fetch dt.entity.mobile_application
            | filter entity.name == $Application
            | fields id
        ]
    | parse event.description, "DATA 'version ' STRING:version ' increased' LD 'to ' DOUBLE:crash.rate.increase.percent ' %' LD"
], on: { version}, fields: { crash.rate.increase.percent, timestamp}, kind:leftOuter
| fieldsAdd crash.rate.increase.percent = coalesce(crash.rate.increase.percent, 0)
| fieldsAdd version = concat(version, "v")

| makeTimeseries crash.rate.increase.percent = avg(crash.rate.increase.percent, default:0), 
    nonempty: true, 
    by: { version}
// by: jose.romero@dynatrace.com
